content.value: Derive the equation of robot trajectory by using the cubic polynomial method. A revolute joint of a robot manipulator is motionless at θ = 25°. It is desired to move the joint in a smooth manner to θ = 95° in 6 sec. Find the equation of position, velocity, and acceleration of the joint as a function of time.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
